Posts on a member's profile and on the company pages they admin.

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own LinkedIn account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/linkedin/callback
```

Add the Sign In with LinkedIn and Share on LinkedIn products to the app; company pages need the Community Management API. Refresh tokens come to approved partners only. Not yet tried against a live connect.

1. Open [linkedin.com](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) and create an OAuth app (also called a client or an integration).
2. Add the redirect URI above.
3. Copy the client ID and client secret. The secret is often shown only once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add linkedin
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  linkedin: { access: "write", scopes: ["posts.write"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | LinkedIn account (who you are) | `openid`, `profile` |
| `posts.write` | Posts on your profile | `openid`, `profile`, `w_member_social` |
| `pages.write` | Company pages you admin (read and post) | `rw_organization_admin`, `w_organization_social`, `r_organization_social` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show linkedin` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect LinkedIn**.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20LinkedIn).
